public_payload.normalized_proposition: If Microsoft cannot afford to keep subsidizing compute, no other company can either.
conditions: if Microsoft cannot afford to keep subsidizing compute

statement.excerpt: Microsoft is arguably the best-capitalized, most-profitable, and best-positioned company to continue subsidizing compute, and if it can’t afford to do so further, nobody else can either.

from_speaker: if it can’t afford to do so further
our_interpretation: The antecedent requires Microsoft's financial inability to continue compute subsidies. Changing a product's prices does not by itself establish that inability.
The comparison concerns other AI providers' ability to finance comparable subsidies, rather than whether every provider chooses the same prices.
The hedged description of Microsoft's relative position is supporting reasoning, not a separate precise financial ranking.
criteria.support_condition: After Microsoft's financial inability to continue comparable compute subsidies is established, evidence establishes that no other relevant provider can finance them.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After the antecedent is established, at least one other provider demonstrably can finance and sustain comparable compute subsidies.
